catalog.title: {platform} Catalog
catalog.loadError: The catalog could not be loaded.

details.title: Game details
details.noSourcesDescription: Add manual download links in this platform catalog's sources[] array when ready.
details.sourceNotice: Sources point to open-source project pages. EmuStore does not host game files.
details.debridUnavailable: Debrid is not available in Web Preview Mode.
details.linkCaptureHelp: Open the source page, check it yourself, then paste the resolved file URL here. The browser cannot read the other tab.
details.pasteResolvedUrlHelp: Paste an HTTP or HTTPS URL ending in the selected platform file extension. EmuStore does not fetch or inspect this URL.
details.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without a username or password.
details.extensionMissing: The URL does not include a filename extension.
details.extensionUnsupported: This extension is not supported by the selected console.
details.extensionMismatch: The link extension does not match this source format.
details.linkFilenameWarning: The URL does not appear to include this game's title or slug. Check it carefully before continuing.
details.linkHostWarning: This URL's host differs from the source page. Expected: {expectedHost}; pasted: {actualHost}. Check the host before continuing.
details.acknowledgeLinkWarnings: I reviewed the warnings and want to continue.
details.linkFormatChecked: This URL passed local format checks. In Web Preview Mode, EmuStore does not inspect the remote file contents or verify the host's integrity or SHA-256 checksum.
details.noTrustedChecksum: No trusted SHA-256 checksum is configured.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Saved preferences for each console catalog.
settings.targetPathsDescription: Saved path suggestions only. This web app cannot inspect console storage or install files.
settings.invalidPath: Each path must contain between 1 and 256 characters.
settings.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Changes could not be saved.
settings.storageNote: Preferences are stored in this browser's local storage.
settings.uiSoundsDescription: Subtle console tones for focus, selection, dialogs, and back actions. Stored in this browser.

reports.title: Report a problem
reports.intro: Your current route, language, and app version are included automatically.
reports.messagePlaceholder: Describe the issue in at least five characters.
reports.messageHelp: Required. Include enough detail to understand the problem.
reports.failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
reports.localValidation: Please enter a description of at least five characters.
reports.validation400: The server rejected the report. Check the required fields and try again. (400 Bad Request)
reports.unavailable503: Report delivery is not configured on the server. Contact the project maintainer. (503 Service Unavailable)
reports.delivery502: The report service could not deliver your report. Try again later. (502 Bad Gateway)
reports.networkError: Could not connect to the report service. Check your connection and try again.
reports.unexpectedError: The report service returned an unexpected response.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.empty: No favorites saved in this browser yet.

downloads.title: Downloads & storage
downloads.queueNote: This is a browser-side queue. It does not download or install files.
downloads.addedToQueue: Source added to the browser queue.
downloads.linkCaptured: Download link captured and added to the browser queue.
downloads.storageNote: Configured path preferences only; device storage is not available to this webpage.

errors.itemNotFound: This item was not found in the selected console catalog.
errors.detailsNotFound: This item is not available in the selected catalog.

updates.statusNoReleases: No GitHub releases have been published yet.
updates.statusRateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.

updates.openedRelease: The release page opened in a new tab. Follow its installation instructions.
